track.title: Homayoun: Mansuri, Zanguleh, Forud
track.notes: Tagged title: Mansouri, Zangouleh, Foroud. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ck5 and dwells most on Bb in Mansuri. Zanguleh (0:14.3) introduces A, Dk, centred on Bb. Forud (0:41.2) introduces F, Gk, D, centred on Bb. The line peaks at D5 (586.4 Hz) at 0:53.1. It closes on the tonic (F4 → Gk4 → F4 → F4 → F4 → F4).
